additional_info.subject: RE: ID0389760-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R0 170002802] Cable was replaced with the wrong cable CRM:00642001783
additional_info.body:
Dear France Service Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0389760 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
The charger was delivered with 3.1 Mtr cable, however in last service activity, the ChademO cable was replaced, and it is a 5 Mtr Cable.
request you to cross verify the service record and contact customer, if customer insist to have a 3.1 mtr cable, here is the
recommended part number
:
8EM5903-0AA01-6AA4
Charging Cable CHAdeMO 125A 500V 3,8m
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Yes
Onsite Troubleshooting
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
After the replacement, you can keep the 5 mtr cable in your stock for future replacement, however you must return the old 3.1 Mtr cable to factory before warranty claim. The sicharge D DC spare return process is described
here
.
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Reetesh Kumar Sharma
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
